recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中淋巴球明顯增加，多為小型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈塊狀、細胞質極少；畫面中有數個破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells），另可見一個中性球，這是 CLL 的典型血液表現。
features: Absolute increase in small mature lymphocytes
Round nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant pale blue cytoplasm
Occasional lymphocytes with slightly more cytoplasm or mildly irregular nuclei
Normochromic, normocytic red cells and a single neutrophil
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm. Numerous smudge cells are present, and a few lymphocytes show slightly more abundant cytoplasm or mildly irregular nuclei. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic, and a single neutrophil is seen. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry showing a monoclonal B-cell count of at least 5 x 10^9/L with a CD5/CD23-positive phenotype.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are more pleomorphic with irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, and smudge cells are not prominent.
SMZL cells show polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are CD5- and CD23-negative.
Pertussis produces small lymphocytes with cleaved nuclei in children, and they are polyclonal T cells.
